findings.sentence: Attio's press release (PR Newswire, 2025-08-26) says Attio has raised $52 million in Series B funding. This is consistent with Crustdata's indexed record (Crunchbase-derived), which lists a Series B of $52,020,932 on 2025-08-26.
findings.limitation: The release is the company's own statement; Crustdata's record is not independent confirmation.

findings.sentence: Attio's press release says the Series B was led by GV (Google Ventures). Crustdata's indexed record (Crunchbase-derived) lists the Series B lead as Google Ventures, the name the release gives in parentheses for GV.
findings.limitation: The lead is the company's own statement; no investor post is in the packet.

findings.sentence: Attio's press release quotes Nicolas Sharp as CEO and co-founder of Attio. Crustdata's identity graph shows Nicolas Sharp (person 34147) as Co-Founder and CEO at Attio 664000.
findings.limitation: The graph title comes from a self-maintained profile; it shows association, not proof.

findings.sentence: Attio's press release quotes Alexander Christie as CTO and co-founder of Attio. Crustdata's identity graph shows Alexander Christie (person 34148) as Co-Founder & CTO at Attio 664000.
findings.limitation: The graph title comes from a self-maintained profile; it shows association, not proof.

findings.sentence: Attio's press release (2025-08-26) says Attio has raised $116 million to date. This is consistent with Crustdata's indexed total of $116,220,932 (Crunchbase-derived).
findings.limitation: A total raised to date is not a round; the figure is the company's own and is as of the release date.
findings.question: Has Attio raised any new capital since the Series B announced on 2025-08-26?
